description: Search the Godot 4.7 class reference offline by words: class, method, property and signal names, keywords and descriptions, best matches first. Use it when you know what you need but not its name ('raycast 3d', 'change scene'), then call godot_api on the best match for its full entry. For where your own project uses a name, use godot_usages. Returns one line per match with its kind and signature, e.g. `method CharacterBody2D.is_on_floor() -> bool const`, or 'no matches'. `limit` caps the list (default 10, at most 50). Read-only.
name: godot_api_search
title: Search the Godot 4.7 API
